comment: Post-release acceptance scenarios (docs/61), run by tools/rungic_acceptance.py after every deploy (smoke) and for release candidates (full). Each scenario names a check function and its parameters; results go to .work/acceptance/<release>/<time>/ and metrics are compared with the previous release's report. Every scenario restores what it changes. 'manual' lists what automatic results do not replace.

scenarios.title: KWin and plasmashell running, session environment written
No failed desktop or bridge user units
No crash signatures during the deploy and the run, except known ones
The Rungic app answers the platform bridge's read-only queries with every field the Linux consumers rely on (quality/contracts/platform-bridge.json)

The shared communication audio service listens for the desktop user and refuses a request without a session (or while another session holds it), as the phone mode's client expects; nothing is opened (quality/contracts/communication-audio.json)

Android's clipboard daemon answers the clipboard's read-only queries (get, watch) as Shell (uid 2000) with every field rungic-plasma-clipboard relies on; the text is blanked on the phone (quality/contracts/clipboard.json)

The Rungic app answers the network service's read-only queries (network-get, the saved networks and scan results) with every field it relies on; names, addresses and lists are blanked on the phone (quality/contracts/network.json)

The Rungic app answers the BlueZ service's state query (the adapter, bonded and found devices) with every field it relies on; names and addresses are blanked on the phone (quality/contracts/bluetooth.json)

The Rungic app answers the telephony state, and the call daemon (served as root) the call status, with every field the Linux side relies on; call numbers are blanked on the phone (quality/contracts/telephony.json)
The Rungic app's capture-info lists the cameras with what the media bridge needs to start their PipeWire nodes (quality/contracts/camera.json); opening a camera is camera.frames
The Rungic app's capture-info has what the media bridge needs to decide on the Android microphone (quality/contracts/audio.json); playing and recording are audio.playback and audio.record
The root controller's read-only actions (account-status, memory-status) and the published install state are what the Rungic app reads (quality/contracts/host-controller.json)

Android's shared storage is mounted in the container (FUSE) and as the account's writable ~/Shared, and the standard directories lead into it (quality/contracts/shared-storage.json); nothing is written

requires_character_device.reason: No /dev/kgsl-3d0: this contract verifies the Qualcomm Adreno KGSL hardware path, unavailable on non-Qualcomm phones such as Pixel 8 Pro (husky).

scenarios.title: The KGSL and DMA heap device nodes are there for the desktop user (read-write, read-only) and render Adreno pixels offscreen through Mesa (quality/contracts/gpu-device.json)

The Rungic app recognizes a blank 64x32 image on the GPU and answers with lines and timings as linux_ocr.py expects (quality/contracts/ocr.json); an app without models starts their download, as a first use would

requires_character_device.reason: No /dev/kgsl-3d0: the current Wi-Fi Display provider uses Qualcomm WFD; it is not supported by this check on non-Qualcomm phones such as husky.

scenarios.title: The casting tool answers status and capabilities through the Rungic app with protocol 1 and everything rungic-cast and the cast quick setting read; TV names are blanked on the phone (quality/contracts/wifi-display.json)
The phone's KScreen output matches the Android display size
Android text input reaches the focused drawer search, which filters to the matching app
PipeWire camera delivers varied frames with increasing timestamps and goes idle after
A Wayland client inhibiting idle keeps the phone screen on while it does (rungic-idle-probe through KWin to the host)
A (quiet) stream enters the default sink, which suspends again afterwards
The default source records a non-zero level and suspends afterwards
Rime engine commits Chinese first candidates; a focused Qt text field brings up the keyboard
Launch and close an app through the launcher by accessible names

Desktop mode starts the independent desktop (workspace 0: its KWin, plasmashell and the floating window) without a cast output on the phone's KWin, and turning it off ends all of it; already on, it is only checked
KScreen applies and reverts a scale change on the phone output
KScreen's adaptive refresh policy and a fixed-rate mode set Android's refresh policy, then restore it
Second camera node delivers frames
Hardware encode (GStreamer) of a test pattern, decode through FFmpeg, duration and frames checked

requires_character_device.reason: No /dev/kgsl-3d0: the current recording check needs the KGSL-backed compositor screencast path; the QPainter desktop on husky is outside this check.

scenarios.title: The recording quick setting writes a playable file with video and audio tracks
Rungic rename, phase B: no installed package, unit or package name is still moto (docs/70)

requires_character_device.reason: No /dev/kgsl-3d0: this benchmark measures the Adreno compositor and KGSL GPU counters; it cannot validate husky software-rendering performance.

scenarios.title: Frame timing of a scripted scroll, compared with the previous release

manual: Visual defects and image quality (display, camera, recording)
Acoustic quality of speaker and microphone
Audio/video synchronisation of recordings, judged by eye and ear
Typing pinyin on the virtual keyboard and committing Chinese (Android key events bypass Rime)
Rime candidate UI and typing feel
Casting to a TV (needs a real receiver, docs/58)
